note:
People whose census rounds disagree about their age by more than the calendar allows - and who, on looking at the household around them, are plainly ONE person with a mistranscribed or misremembered age rather than two people welded together. tools_split_by_birth_year.py skips anyone listed here.

The record keeps the age the page gives. It is not corrected, because the page says what it says; the conflict is noted in the source line instead. What is recorded here is only that somebody has looked.
